verdict.rationale: Gazebo exposes programmatic control through Gazebo Transport socket-based message passing to a remote or headless server, public C++ libraries (gz-transport, gz-math, sdformat), a plugin API, and CLI tools for simulation introspection and control. However, the interface is C++/transport-oriented and not a web-style API: probes found no OpenAPI spec, no llms.txt and no markdown docs. The evidence pack also contains no actual API reference content. Missing for 10: an OpenAPI/REST-style machine-readable API description, AI-friendly docs (llms.txt or markdown), API reference detail for the transport topics and services, and independent or hands-on confirmation of driving the simulator programmatically.
